content.title: How Many Commonwealth Advisors Left LPL? New Report Shows Slew of Exits.
content.summary: When  LPL Financial   said it would acquire rival wealth manager Commonwealth Financial Network last March, Commonwealth’s approximately 2,900 advisors had a choice: stay with LPL or find a new home.  A new report sheds light on how many Commonwealth advisors have headed for the exits.  From the time of the acquisition announcement until the end of last year, 653 Commonwealth advisors, or 22.5%, took the latter path, according to the report, from AdvizorPro and Muriel Consulting.
